good_to_know: Columbarium open daily 6am–10pm; lift runs daily 9am–7pm, and 8.30am–12 noon on public holidays.
For Last Rites or urgent care for the seriously ill, call 6344 0046 to reach the priest on duty.
Katong Catholic Shop is at the parish: Tue–Fri 12 noon–6.30pm, Sat–Sun 8.30am–5.30pm; closed Mondays and public holidays.
